landmarks.name: White Serpent and Crimson Viper
landmarks.description:
How to obtain:
Defeat Bai Chilian.

Weapon assessment:

A weapon with very generous stats. Its drawback is the high cost of its Sha-Chi skill, so pair it with an accessory that reduces Sha-Chi consumption.

landmarks.name: [Powerful] The Fanatic's Broken Blade
landmarks.description:
How to obtain:

Defeat Hua Qianxiao, the Sword Fanatic.

Weapon assessment:

Using the special skill to drink turns it into a partly ranged weapon, which is useful for clearing regular enemies. Unfortunately, its stats are low and it requires drinking; when the drunken effect wears off, it leaves you unable to act. Switching it out for boss fights is recommended.

It might be a crutch, though calling it one also seems a little unlikely.

landmarks.name: [Crutch] Outlaw Warblade
landmarks.description:
How to obtain:
Defeat Jing Ye, The Outlaw.

Weapon assessment:

Personally, I consider this one of the weapons that makes the game much easier. Its stats are low, but it steals health.

Its Power Surge is exceptionally powerful: a forceful grab with super armor that deals substantial damage and restores half your health on a hit.

The regular Sha-Chi skill is not very useful early on because it is difficult to recover the health it costs, but after +15 you can use it more often.

Since you generally do not use the regular Sha-Chi skill, your Sha-Chi gauge tends to stay fuller. It is strong and takes little input, making it an easy way through the game.

Put it in slot 2. Use the Jagged Steel in slot 1 to build up Sha-Chi, then switch weapons and use the Power Surge to steal health.

landmarks.name: Flying Dagger
landmarks.description:

Complete Quick Hand's Request in the Crimson Forest region.

landmarks.name: Iron Gauntlets
landmarks.description:
How to obtain:
Defeat Stone Hand Iron Fever.

Weapon assessment:

The standout Phantom Edge: it can break shields, deal damage, and even grant an attack buff. At level 15, you can also use guard-point blocks. Recommended all the way to the end of your first playthrough.

Obtain this before proceeding to Chapter 3.

landmarks.name: Severely Wounded Baishan Disciple
landmarks.description:
How to Unlock the Secrets of the Baishan Sect Quest
Location: Crimson Forest
Speak to Ju and Lanlan on the bridge towards the camp.
From the bridge, progress through the village ahead until you reach the Cliffside Lodge bell. Pick up the key upstairs of the lodge and use it on the socket downstairs to unlock the entrance to the dungeons.
The Severely Wounded Baishan Disciple can be found behind a locked chamber, the key for this door can be obtained on a body on the right side of the stairs in the dungeon by a chest.

landmarks.name: The Gentle Thief
landmarks.description: After crossing the bridge, go inside the house on the right and talk to the Irreverent Thief to progress the quest Honor Among Thieves. He'll ask you 3 questions, and if you answer all 3 correctly, he'll give you the Silent Wrap accessory. The answers are as follows: "Stole a landowner's jade belt", "Butterfly", and "The letter never said. His fate is unknown".

landmarks.name: Ju and Lanlan
landmarks.description:

landmarks.name: Secrets of the Baishan Sect
landmarks.description:
How to Unlock the Secrets of the Baishan Sect Quest
Location: Crimson Forest
Speak to Ju and Lanlan on the bridge towards the camp.
From the bridge, progress through the village ahead until you reach the Cliffside Lodge bell. Pick up the key upstairs of the lodge and use it on the socket downstairs to unlock the entrance to the dungeons.
The Severely Wounded Baishan Disciple can be found behind a locked chamber, the key for this door can be obtained on a body on the right side of the stairs in the dungeon by a chest.
Head back down to the locked chamber and use the key to unlock it and speak with the disciple, she will ask you to save the sect.

landmarks.name: Honor Among Thieves
landmarks.description:
Prerequisite:

On reaching the western side, first head south. Defeat the enemies to obtain the document Wulin Tales (Thief's Blood Letter) and start the Local Tale Honor Among Thieves (Starting Point).

Quest reward:

Silent Wrap

Objective:

Give the Blood Letter from the Nimble Thief to The Gentle Thief at the Thieves' Camp Bell.

Notes:

Choose these answers: "Stole the wealthy landowner's jade belt" → "Butterfly" → "The blood-written letter did not mention it; the whereabouts seem to be unknown." You receive the Silent Wrap accessory.

landmarks.description:
Prerequisites:
Head east into the cave and pick up Inanis' Memory Flower - I. The Performance at the fork. This also triggers the Resonant Strings collection quest.

Notes:
Be sure to collect all 6 Memory Flowers in this series before fighting the area's final boss; this makes the boss battle more exciting and reduces its difficulty.

landmarks.name: Iron Fiend and Jade Dancer
landmarks.description:
Reward:
Heel Reinforcement Part (Soul Tempering material for Fiend Saws).

Strategy Tips:

landmarks.name: Bai Chilian, Lady of the Twin Serpents
landmarks.description:
Rewards:

Weapon: White Serpent & Crimson Viper

Charm: Resonance Talisman

Combat tips:

Collect all 6 of the Chord's Memory Flowers. She will help you fight the boss in the second phase.

landmarks.name: Jing Ye, the Outlaw
landmarks.description:
Reward:

The Banyan's Heart, used to unlock special abilities on the skill tree.

Combat tips:

He appears in the final wave inside the Human-Faced Banyan. His moves are the same as before, but this time he has underlings with him. Their aggro seems to be separate, so you can deal with the smaller enemies first.

landmarks.name: The Gold-Masked One
landmarks.description:
Interact with the Long Pillar to enter the Discordance and challenge the Gold-Masked One.

Reward:

Miraculous Scabbard

Combat tips:

He has an additional black-aura skill this time, but no longer becomes intangible and invincible. Dodge the black-aura skill to avoid having your Sha-Chi drained completely.

He also has a move where he turns red and winds up for 2 charging attacks. When you see the windup, silently count 1 second, then dodge.

landmarks.name: Stone Hand Iron Fever
landmarks.description:
Reward:

Phantom Edge: Iron Gauntlets

Combat tips:

The boss powers up at 2/3 health, but does not have a second health bar. Fight normally, alternating offense and defense; this is a fairly balanced boss.

landmarks.name: Jing Ye, the Outlaw
landmarks.description:
This guy has killed me more times than Master Ye. Anyone else?

------------------

Reward:

Outlaw Warblade weapon

Combat tips:

Equip the shieldbreaking and anti-cavalry charms. When the boss reaches 2/3 health, he dismounts and fights with a shield.

The shield is spiked, so attacking recklessly reflects damage back at you. Break the shield before attacking.

landmarks.name: [Late-game Unlock] No. 34 - Chaos Puppet: "Jade Cong"
landmarks.description:
A hidden boss in this game. Prerequisites:

1. Start the Wulin Tale Triple Threat: at The Lady's Rift Bell, interact with the rift to enter and fight the Aberrant Three-Faced Puppet once.

2. Memory Flowers: find all 3 Chaos Puppet Memory Flowers at Mirage Estate.

3. Story progress: complete Mirage Estate and enter Mount Soulrend.

Optional condition:
Soul Temper Sanguine Reach: collect Blazing Flame (Zhu Yuan, the Searing Blade; locations: Meigu Lake, Pangzhen Sha-Chi Tower Base) + Cooled Flame's Grasp (obtained from the third Lóng Pillar challenge on the east side of Meigu Lake). Once you have both, find Myst in Pangzhen to Soul Temper Sanguine Reach.

The boss gains an additional ice phase, and you also receive one extra Soul Tempering material for Sanguine Twin.

landmarks.name: Hua Qianxiao, the Sword Fanatic
landmarks.description:
Reward:

The Fanatic's Broken Blade

Combat tips:

Equip the Shieldbreaker Talisman accessory. While Hua Qianxiao is charging an attack, break his shield with the Dread Axe to break his guard immediately.

landmarks.name: Crimson Forest Starting Point
landmarks.description: The collectibles in this level are not too difficult to find either, though the difficulty steps up a little. You can do it!

landmarks.name: Mirrorwood Puzzle Solution
landmarks.description:
First puzzle:
On reaching the Mirrorwood, you will find a mirror on the left, one ahead, and one on the right.
Examine the writing on the tree. It tells you to follow the weeping: enter whichever mirror has the sound of crying.
Choosing the correct mirror teleports you to the starting point shown in the image below. Keep choosing mirrors; there are 3 choices in total.

The correct order is: left → ahead → right.

After all 3 correct choices, a path appears ahead.

Second puzzle:

Continue forward to find another set of mirrors: left, ahead, and right.

This time, the correct order is: right → left → ahead.

After all 3 correct choices, a path appears ahead. Go outside and activate the Threadbound Great Tree Bell.
